question: Which is the oldest tennis tournament in the world?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Wimbledon**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wimbledon:** 

 
 
• **The Championships, Wimbledon,** commonly known simply as Wimbledon, is the** oldest tennis tournament in the world,** and it is considered the most prestigious. 
 
• It has been held at the** All England Club** in **Wimbledon, London, since 1877.** 
 
• **Wimbledon** takes place over two weeks in late **June** and early **July.** 
 
• It is the only major tournament still played on grass, which is the game's original surface.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Australian Open: **

 
 
• **The Australian Open** is one of the **four Grand Slam tennis tournaments**.
 
• It is held annually in** Melbourne, Australia,** in the last two weeks of** January.**
 
• The tournament was first held in **1905,** making it the** youngest of the four Grand Slam events.**
 
 
 
• **French Open:**
 
 
• Also known as **Roland-Garros**, this is another of the **four annual Grand Slam tournaments.**
 
• It is held in **Paris, France, over two weeks in late May and early June.**
 
• The French Open was established in **1891**, making it the third oldest of the four Grand Slam tournaments.
 
 
 
• **US Open: **
 
 
• **The US Open** is held annually in** late August and early September **over a two-week period in **New York City, United States.**
 
• The US Open originated from two separate tournaments: the men's tournament which started in** 1881 and the women's tournament which started in 1887.**
